This mushroom is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in jungles and rainforests, and is best known in southern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains hard to find.

Eating Hopperfoot fungus sends the patient into a deep sleep lasting eight hours. At the end of that rest, the patient regains 2–20 concussion hits. Uncontrollable flatulence often accompanies the sleep, and repeated use can cause habituation. The wounded character therefore needs a safe place to remain undisturbed throughout the treatment.
